title: Create Potato: Aeronautics
description: The most optimized way to play Create Aeronautics on a potato. Or even a powerful PC!
body:
# 🥔 Create Potato: Aeronautics Edition

A performance-first Minecraft modpack specifically engineered to be the **fastest and most optimized** experience for **Create Aeronautics**.

![Up to 100% more FPS on Low-End PCs (12 Chunks)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c175e745dcf2d14340c8b0f0140990e6c8dcc87d.png)
*Up to 100% more FPS on Low-End PCs (12 Chunks), performance tested on integrated graphics (Ryzen 5 4500U, Vega 6).*

---

## 🚀 Best-in-Class Performance
**Create Potato** delivers the **BEST performance** of any modpack in its category. It is tuned to handle the complex physics and entity-heavy calculations of **Create Aeronautics**, ensuring that your airships fly smoothly even on lower-end hardware. Expect lightning-fast load times, superior chunk-loading, and the most stable FPS available for aeronautical engineers.

## 🛠️ Utility
This pack includes a curated suite of utility mods to make your aviation and building experience more comfortable:
* **Full Brightness Toggle (G)**
* **Just Enough Items (JEI)**
* **Just Enough Resources (JER)**
* **Mouse Tweaks** (please refer to mod page for details)
* **Xaero's Minimap**
* **Xaero's World Map (M)**

> [!NOTE]
> These mods are all client-side and **DO NOT AFFECT performance**.

## 🎨 Shaders & Resource Packs
Thanks to **Iris Shaders** and **Continuity**, this modpack supports shaders and resource packs. The optimization modpacks allows you to run shaders with better stability than vanilla, making your aerial world look stunning without the typical performance hit.

![Patrix 32x + Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e86d0b6393e4a9a5fd55332a9c605a7036ba4e14_0.webp)
*Patrix 32x + Complementary Shaders - Reimagined*
